title: BTS Sukhumvit Line 3D — Authentic Bangkok City & Driver Simulator
description: A complete, self-contained interactive 3D Bangkok Skytrain simulator in vanilla HTML5/CSS3/ES6, rendered with Three.js r128 and OrbitControls. It models all 47 operational Sukhumvit Line stations from Khu Khot N24 to Kheha E23, four procedural city zones, elevated third-rail kinematics, a four-car train with sliding doors, an auto pilot, four cameras, a bilingual EN/TH transit HUD and Web Audio synthesis.

build.includes: Initial Three.js foundation, route survey and viaduct, four-zone procedural city, 47 stations and platform furniture, Chatuchak, Victory Monument, Siam skywalk, Terminal 21, Benchasiri Park, Erawan elephant, Khu Khot depot, Kheha terminus, four-car train with doors and interior, bilingual telemetry HUD, minimap, station list, four cameras, auto pilot, door interlock, terminus reversal, Web Audio engine, time-of-day modes, mobile layout, 33-check self-test, documentation, screenshots and GitHub packaging.

features: 47 operational Sukhumvit Line stations, N24 Khu Khot to E23 Kheha (N6 Sena Ruam omitted as unopened)
Four procedural city zones: northern suburbs, central core, Sukhumvit corridor and southern delta
Zone-aware building density, heights, palettes, glass ratio, trees and landmarks
Elevated viaduct with deck, parapets, piers, ballastless track, running rails and a glowing third rail
47 side-platform stations with canopies, Thai/English name boards, benches, lamps, lifts, signals and waiting passengers
Four-car BTS train with green waistline, gold pinstripe, BTS roundels, window band, sliding doors, interior, bogies, headlights and destination displays
Throttle 0–80 km/h, service brake, emergency brake, coasting and door interlock
Auto pilot that accelerates, brakes, serves every platform, dwells, closes doors, departs and reverses at termini
Four cameras: driver cab, passenger scenic window, free orbit and platform arrival cam
Bilingual EN/TH HUD with station names, zone descriptions, toasts, announcements and control labels
Live telemetry: speed, distance, ETA, zone, interchange chips, nearby landmark, route progress and minimap
Clickable 47-station list and Next Stop jump control
Web Audio motor hum, inverter whine, track thuds, door chime, PA chime, horn, brake squeal and city ambience
Day, golden hour and night modes with lit windows, neon billboards, stars and headlights
Landmarks: Chatuchak, Victory Monument, Siam Skywalk, Terminal 21, Benchasiri Park, Erawan Museum, Khu Khot Depot, Kheha Terminus, Wat Phra Sri Mahathat, ARL, Samrong Yellow Line and Pak Nam
Mobile layout with minimised telemetry and reflowed control dock
